bifrost: bifrost_app::audio (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:88 re-exports springboard::svc::audio), springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (audio), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/media/, springboard/sdk/src/audio_application.rs, springboard/sdk/src/audio_player_control.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a system audio service (audiod) that owns the speaker and microphone, with playback queue, volume, mute and WAV recording exposed to apps through the SDK audio client. App-level permission and input mute, player pan, rate and volume fades are modelled in the SDK; session categories, interruptions and route notifications are modelled but not wired to audiod. The AVAudioEngine graph and MIDI playback have no full app-facing counterpart; speech synthesis is app-facing through the shell speech service (espeak-ng) but partial; the output route is switched by the shell alone.

features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): the route the shell reports now reaches the session hub (Cmd::SetRoute to audiod, Evt::Route to subscribers, audio::Client::take_route_changes, SessionHub::apply_service_route). Category, mode, options, activation and interruptions are still the local pure model, not arbitrated in audiod. Midget check: run `bifrost-audio watch 30` and plug and unplug headphones: it prints `route headphones (a device appeared)` and `route speaker (a device went away)`.

features.apple: AVAudioApplication: requestRecordPermission, recordPermission, input mute state
features.note: recording is gated by an explicit user tap in the app (verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests). The pure model asks for the permission only while it is undetermined, keeps a refusal until settings change it, and queues one event per input mute change; all of it is tested headless. Gap: the shell's prompt and mute switch do not feed the model, so the live permission check needs the lab machine and audiod.
category, mode, options (mixWithOthers, duckOthers), setActive and interruption began/ended with shouldResume modelled; not wired to audiod yet, needs a Midget check

Shell::set_route sends Cmd::SetRoute { headphones, reason } to audiod (also after every service reconnect), audiod keeps the route and pushes Evt::Route to its subscribers and to each new subscriber, and an app feeds it to its SessionHub with audio_session::apply_service_routes, getting RouteChange with the reason (1 a device appeared, 2 it went away). The model still has no device choice beyond the preferred input, and the shell reports only jack and route-picker changes, not Bluetooth sinks. Midget check: `bifrost-audio watch 30`, then plug the headset into the jack (or pick Headphones in Control Center) and unplug it: each change prints a `route ...` line.
Apple Bluetooth audio routing; no BifrOSt counterpart

features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): pan and volume fades reach the speaker. audiod applies Cmd::SetPan (a balance: the far channel falls to silence) and Cmd::FadeVolume (the gain is ramped across each block, the state volume follows, SetVolume cancels) in media/audioplayer.rs through media/player_fx.rs; Client::set_pan and fade_volume and Command::pan and fade_volume expose them; the rate was already time-stretched. The player is one shared player and the UI wires only volume. Midget check: play a song in Music, then `bifrost-audio pan -1` (left speaker only), `bifrost-audio pan 0`, `bifrost-audio fade 0 3000` (fades out over 3 s) and `bifrost-audio status` (the volume follows the fade).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/speech.rs (bifrost_app::speech: Utterance, speak, stop, pause, continue_speaking, is_speaking, voices); springboard/src/shell/services/speech.rs (the speech service, one engine child per app); springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs (engine arguments and voice listing); springboard/ui/src/speech.rs (utterance and voice model); wired: springboard/apps/books-desktop/src/books/narrate.rs (Narration over springboard/ui/src/speech.rs); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop, springboard/apps/textedit-desktop (Speech menu)
features.note: Speaks through the system engine espeak-ng (else espeak), as a child process of the shell. The app-facing API now exists: speak with voice and rate, stop, pause and continue (SIGSTOP and SIGCONT), is_speaking and the voice list. Host unit tests cover the engine arguments, the voice listing parser and the service state machine with a fake engine. No word or sentence events, no pitch or volume, and the Apple synthesizer's utterance delegate is not modelled. Not yet tested on Midget; espeak-ng must be installed there. The earlier parity claim rested on the pure model alone and is withdrawn.

gaps: No app-facing audio session category, mode or activation API (AVAudioSession): modelled in audio_session.rs, not wired to audiod
Route changes reach apps (shell, audiod, audio::Client, SessionHub::apply_service_route); interruptions are modelled in audio_session.rs and not arbitrated in audiod.
AVAudioApplication permission and input mute: modelled in audio_application.rs, not wired to the shell or the recording path
The node graph (ui audio_engine.rs: player, gain, mixer and low-pass nodes, exposed as bifrost_sdk::audio_engine) has no verified real-time output path on Midget.
MIDI playback is bifrost_app::midi_player through the additive General MIDI synth; there is no sound bank or sampled instrument.
Speech synthesis has no word or sentence events, pitch or volume control, and no delegate callbacks; the shell speech service (espeak-ng) is the only engine
AVAudioPlayer pan and volume fade are applied by audiod (the UI wires only volume); rate was already applied.
